name: Al Faisaliah Hotel
insider_take: This iconic glass tower isn't just a hotel – it's Riyadh's most recognizable landmark and the kingdom's first luxury skyscraper, crowned with a spectacular golden sphere that lights up the desert skyline.
whats_special: The hotel occupies floors 1-16 of the famous Al Faisaliah Tower, Saudi Arabia's third-tallest building. The golden Globe restaurant on the 20th floor offers 360-degree views of the capital, while the hotel houses the kingdom's first luxury shopping mall at its base. The property seamlessly blends traditional Arabian hospitality with cutting-edge modern design.
pro_tip: Book a table at The Globe for sunset dining – the panoramic views of Riyadh's sprawling cityscape and desert beyond are absolutely breathtaking, especially during the golden hour when the city transforms into a glittering oasis.
dont_miss: Visit the Four Seasons Spa on the 15th floor for treatments with views, explore the exclusive Al Faisaliah Mall's luxury boutiques, and experience traditional Saudi coffee service in the ornate lobby lounge. The hotel's location puts you walking distance from the Kingdom Centre and Riyadh's premier business district.
pros: Iconic landmark tower in the heart of Riyadh's business district
Exceptional Mandarin Oriental service standards and luxury amenities
Prime location with easy access to King Khalid International Airport
Multiple award-winning dining venues and rooftop experiences
cons: Located in busy commercial area with high traffic
